name: Canonicalized Alignment-aware Positional Memory
scientific_question: Global PatchCore lets any-position patches match, so 'locally normal appearance at the wrong position' is missed; hard position limits break under pose offset. Feasibility question FIRST (this R0): can query-reference geometry be canonicalized with frozen DINO patch features alone — mutual nearest-neighbor correspondences + RANSAC affine — with enough inliers and low reprojection error on MPDD? If most images cannot be aligned reliably (inlier ratio < 0.3), the route FAILS before any pixel evaluation.

data.features: cached dino vitb14 patch features (test + K refs) from outputs/dynamic_fusion/v3_direction_a/features_vitb14_s0_k1/anomalydino_visual/{cat}.npz
data.sample: all test images per category for statistics (subsample capped for feasibility reporting)

feasibility_statistics.correspondences: mutual nearest neighbors between query image patch features and each reference image patch features (faiss, cosine via L2-normalized)
feasibility_statistics.fit: RANSAC affine (cv2.estimateAffinePartial2D or full affine), maxIters=2000, reprojThresh=2.0 (patch units); no GT used
feasibility_statistics.reported: per image: n mutual matches, inlier count, inlier ratio, mean reprojection error; per category: median/mean inlier ratio, fraction of images with inlier ratio >= 0.3
feasibility_statistics.class_groups: geometry-stable classes (connector, metal_plate, tubes ...) vs others; BOTH the geometric subset and the full-6-class summary are reported

early_fail_rule: if the majority of test images (median across classes) have RANSAC inlier ratio < 0.3, or full-6-class aligned fraction < 40%, route FAILS pre-registered (no pixel evaluation, archive feasibility evidence)
post_pass_plan: only if feasibility passes: implement d_global + 0.25*relu(d_pos-d_global) with alignment_reliability fallback; gates: full-6-class mean Pixel-AP >= +0.003, >=4/6 positive, worst >= -0.015, low-reliability outputs max error vs A1 <= 1e-6, real vs random-homography alignment >= +0.003
leakage: no GT anywhere in alignment; no per-category hand-picked transforms
